evidence.name: Screen field: Restore background rounding
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Restore background rounding" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Restore background rounding
sections.description: Rounds the corners of the restore link's background block, from 0 (sharp rectangle) up to 50 (full pill). It only shows once you've given the link a background color and opacity. Use a higher value for a pill-shaped chip; the default of 0 is fine, and you can ignore it entirely if there's no background fill.
